newest.title: US Bans DeepSeek from Federal Systems: What This Means for Your Tech
newest.description: US Bans DeepSeek from Federal Systems: What This Means for Your Tech. The US government is pulling DeepSeek out of federal IT systems, and Microsoft is rolling out 'Guardian Agents' to watch your AI's every move. We're breaking down what these shifts mean for your own digital security and the future of automated work. What we covered: • AP reports US ban of DeepSeek from federal civilian agencies, with China warning of retaliation • OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to connect AI models with biopharma workflows • Microsoft says enterprises need guardian agents to manage AI agents as insider risks Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: If an AI agent makes a mistake that costs your company money, who should be held responsible? What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed. Who wins. What you do next. Follow The AI Edge on Spotify for a new AI news and analysis episode every weekday.
